newsitem.title: FRANCE: Three French Elf plants extend strike to late Tues.
newsitem.headline: Three French Elf plants extend strike to late Tues.

text.p: Workers at all three Elf Aquitaine refineries in France have now extended a five-day-old strike until Tuesday evening, a spokesman for France's biggest union, the CFDT, said on Monday.
Earlier a union official said workers at one of the plants, the Grandpuits refinery near Paris, had made such a decision.
The strike over planned job cuts had previously been due to end on Monday evening or Tuesday morning. It began last Wednesday at Grandpuits and last Thursday at Donges and Feyzin.
Talks are scheduled for 1400 GMT on Tuesday, union officials said, but it was not clear whether these would address their wider demands on early retirement and other benefits.
Union officials said employers at Elf's distribution arm Elf Antar wanted to restrict talks to the narrower question of pay.
Elf has not so far commented on the strike.
